Unit Converter

Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, data, speed and area. Real conversion tables with exact factors; temperature uses the proper C/F/K formulas.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a category: Length, Weight, Temperature, Data, Speed or Area.
  2. Enter a value.
  3. Choose the From and To units.
  4. The converted result appears instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate are the conversions?

Length, weight, data, speed and area use exact multiplicative factors. Temperature converts through Celsius with the standard formulas.

Why is temperature handled differently?

Temperature needs addition, not just multiplication: F = C x 9/5 + 32 and K = C + 273.15.

Are kilobytes 1000 or 1024 bytes here?

Data units use the binary standard: 1 KB = 1024 bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB, and so on.
